title: VTC: specify reconnection semantics
description: When a participant's connection drops and they rejoin, the draft is silent on whether they get a new VTCParticipant entry or update the existing one. Both Jitsi and Zoom handle this transparently (same participant, updated join time). Specify that a participant who re-joins updates their existing entry: clears leftAt, updates joinedAt, preserves role and speakerTimeMs.
close_reason: Added Reconnecting section to VTCParticipant/set specifying that re-joining updates the existing record rather than creating a new one.
